Error Codes

Errors are returned as JSON objects with the fields code, message and request_id. Always include the request_id when contacting support.

Client Errors

CodeHTTPMeaning
TW-400-PARAM400A query parameter is missing or malformed.
TW-401-KEY401The API key is missing, unknown or revoked.
TW-403-SCOPE403The OAuth token lacks the required scope.
TW-403-BLOCKED403The key is temporarily blocked after ignoring rate limits.
TW-404-STATION404The station ID does not exist or was decommissioned.
TW-429-RATE429Rate limit exceeded; see the Retry-After header.

Server Errors

TW-500-INTERNAL500Unexpected server error. Safe to retry after a short delay.
TW-503-BUOY-OFFLINE503The buoy has not reported for more than 2 hours; data may be stale.

Retrying

Only retry requests that failed with 429, 500 or 503. Never retry 400-level errors other than 429 without changing the request.
